power.baseline_method: Training-only 90th-percentile performance ratio, clipped to 0.4–1.0; configured panel/lux/temperature assumptions are unverified.
power.acceptance_policy: Finite held-out error, nonnegative R2 when defined, RMSE no more than 5% above the engineering baseline. This policy is not field accuracy assurance.
power.imputation: Medians fitted on training rows only; entirely missing training features excluded.
power.horizon: Current conditions only; not a weather-ahead forecast
power.units: Power errors in milliwatts; R2 dimensionless and Unavailable for a constant target.

limitations: Offline current-condition evaluation only. No real-site accuracy, future weather skill, verified fault taxonomy or confidence interval is established.
